title: Sand Alchemist — Elemental Cellular Automata

checks.name: JavaScript syntax
checks.details: engine.js and app.js parse with no syntax errors.

checks.name: Reaction and preset self-test
checks.details: Deterministic tests passed for sand fall, water flow, fire consuming wood, oil floating, lava boiling water, ice melting, steam rising, salt dissolving, plant growth, volcano materials, and attract-scene steam.

checks.name: Local-only HTML contract, materials, and sim timing
checks.command: node -e "var fs=require('fs'); var html=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8'); var all=html+fs.readFileSync('styles.css','utf8')+fs.readFileSync('app.js','utf8')+fs.readFileSync('engine.js','utf8'); if(/https?:\/\//.test(all)) process.exit(1); ['world','fps','cells','material','brush','seed','mat-search','pause-btn','step-btn','clear-btn','reset-btn','speed','preset-summary'].forEach(function(id){ if(html.indexOf('id=\"'+id+'\"')<0) process.exit(1); }); var vm=require('vm'); var ctx={console:console, process:{argv:['node','app']}, module:{exports:{}}, globalThis:null}; ctx.globalThis=ctx; vm.runInNewContext(fs.readFileSync('engine.js','utf8'), ctx); var SA=ctx.SandAlchemist; ['Empty','Sand','Water','Stone','Wood','Plant','Fire','Oil','Ice','Steam','Lava','Salt'].forEach(function(n){ if(SA.NAMES.indexOf(n)<0) process.exit(1); }); var w=new SA.World(0xA13C3); w.loadPreset('volcano'); var t0=Date.now(); for(var i=0;i<60;i++) w.step(); var ms=Date.now()-t0; var steam=0; for(var j=0;j<w.count;j++) if(w.type[j]===SA.STEAM) steam++; if(ms>4000||steam<1) process.exit(1); console.log('timing_ms', ms, 'steam', steam);"
checks.details: No remote URLs. Required HUD ids and twelve named materials present. 60 volcano ticks ran in 382ms with 938 steam cells remaining, showing the attract scene stays reactive at default resolution.

summary: Sand Alchemist is a disk-open Canvas 2D falling-sand laboratory: a 400×225 heat-aware grid in a 1600×900 terrarium, twelve required materials plus ash, zigzag/moved-stamp updates, four seeded presets, and full paint/pause/speed controls.
